summary: Kustom Entertainment filed an 8-K reporting corporate housekeeping matters rather than a special situation. Effective October 1, 2026, the company effected a board-approved 1-for-10 reverse stock split and proportionate capital reduction, cutting outstanding shares from 6,506,860 to 650,686 and authorized shares from 13,333,333 to 1,333,334; the stock trades split-adjusted on Nasdaq under new CUSIP 25382T705. The same filing reports the October 5, 2026 annual meeting, where 3,419,508 shares (about 52.55% of the August 7 record-date float) established a quorum on eleven proposals. No deal terms, advisors, or special-situation mechanics are stated; the risk-arb angle is nil.
